title: The Goldman Sachs Group (GS) Just Made Its Fourth Asset-Management Deal in a Year
title_zh: 高盛集团 (GS) 刚刚完成一年内的第四笔资产管理交易
summary: On August 18, 2026, The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE:GS) agreed to buy real estate investment firm LCN Capital Partners for up to $410 million, its fourth asset-management acquisition in less than a year and second deal in under 10 days.
summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月 18 日，高盛集团 (NYSE:GS) 同意以高达 4.1 亿美元的价格收购房地产投资公司 LCN Capital Partners，这是其不到一年内的第四次资产管理收购，也是不到 10 天内的第二笔交易。
